data_and_security.connects: Your email, only if you connect it (sending reports; reading your inbox for outcomes only if you later say yes), and employers' public career pages.
data_and_security.exit: "Pause my fleet" any time; "remove my fleet" takes the whole thing out, with a report of what was removed.
data_and_security.holds: Your resume, your profile, what it has checked, and your applications and their outcomes.
data_and_security.kept: Mailbox-derived files for 90 days; report history for the last 8 cycles; the rest until you remove the fleet.
data_and_security.lives: In your Muse and your files. Nothing of yours is sent to the seller. Ever.
data_and_security.never: Touches LinkedIn, asks for your passwords, applies without your approval on that application, or invents experience.
data_and_security.untrusted_content: Job postings, career pages, and emails the fleet reads are untrusted content: they are read for facts and are never obeyed as instructions.

does_not_fit: Job searches outside the United States: the employer registries and board engines are US-based and filter out non-US postings
First jobs, internships, and trainee roles: the scoring gate sets entry-level postings aside
Fields with only a handful of employers already visible on one job board
Anyone expecting a guaranteed job: no honest system can promise one

fingerprint.note: The fingerprint of this zip is published at agent_record_url and on the purchase page. It is deliberately not stated inside the package: a file cannot carry the hash of the archive that contains it. Verify the downloaded zip against the published fingerprint before installing.

fits: An experienced professional whose job search has become a second, unpaid job
A job search in the United States, or targeting US-based and US-remote roles
An owner who wants applications handled for them, with a human approval before anything is submitted
Cleared professionals seeking cleared work (a Defense lane opens from the owner's own stated clearance)

install.how: The owner attaches this zip in a chat with their assistant and sends the install prompt. The assistant then follows SETUP.md in this package exactly: three steps, shown to the owner as Step 1 of 3 (profile), Step 2 of 3 (fleet built), Step 3 of 3 (first sweep). The first Fleet Report is delivered in the same sitting by the route the owner chose in setup (email, or in-chat where the owner chose in-chat delivery).
install.prompt: Install and set up my job fleet from this zip file.
install.staged_consent: Each capability asks at its moment; declining pauses only that capability.
install.update_behavior: Installing a newer package over an existing fleet carries the owner's profile, history, and application records forward. Nothing earned is reset by an update. An update is accepted only when the new zip matches the SHA-256 published for that version and the new version is higher than the one installed.
install.update_prompt: Update my job fleet from this zip file.

operation.approval_rule: Nothing is ever applied for without the owner's approval on that specific application
operation.reporting: One Fleet Report per cycle, plus an instant alert only when an approved application is actually submitted. A cycle that could not check a board says so, naming the board and the reason; a gap is never reported as a zero.
operation.rotation: Most lanes run inside a 48-hour rotation; a few run on weekly slots

price.refunds: No refunds; the buyer receives the complete files at purchase, so the sale is final. Platform exceptions (fraud, duplicate purchase) and statutory withdrawal rights (EU 14 days, Brazil 7 days) are honored by Gumroad.
price.updates: Every update is included in the purchase price and delivered through Gumroad.

requirements: An AI assistant account the owner controls (the fleet was built and tested on Muse AI; a paid plan is recommended because setup is token-heavy and a free plan's allowance burns quickly)
The owner's resume, in any common document format
An email route the owner connects and allows, for the Fleet Report and application alerts (the fleet uses the route in the owner's profile; it never guesses an account)
support_model: The fleet maintains itself: a built-in fleet doctor performs provably safe repairs, a troubleshooting guide ships in the package (core/TROUBLESHOOTING.md), and a weekly health check folds into the Fleet Report. Field improvement notes, not error reports, are the channel back to the maker.
what_it_is: A job-search system that runs inside the owner's own AI assistant account. On a 48-hour rotation it reads live postings on employers' own career pages (1,400+ employers, 18 scanning lanes plus the Careers Monitor watch lane, including Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, and iCIMS), scores each posting against the owner's resume by duties performed rather than job titles, delivers one Fleet Report per cycle, and submits applications only with the owner's approval on each application. A companion layer reads the owner's resume and the roles they have already applied to against the postings the fleet has collected, and writes plain-language briefs: interjections about the owner's own search, signals (roles open for months; roles that disappeared and came back), and horizon notes on roles forming before they have a settled name.
